items.name: Bowerbird Organizing
items.summary: Professional-organizer site has a warm local story but the first screen can make consultation CTA, trust, and service paths easier to scan.
items.angle: same-site cleanup: clearer hero, service paths by project type, trust/reviews near the top, and a simpler consultation next-step flow.

items.name: Prairie Path Painters
items.summary: Older Wix-style painting page lists services and free estimates, but CTA hierarchy, proof, and scanability can be tightened without changing the brand feel.
items.angle: preserve the simple painterly identity while bringing free-estimate action, trust proof, and service grouping higher on the page.

items.name: Reform Painting Services
items.summary: Live Wix service page still shows M&B Remodeling template residue and placeholder paragraph copy, making it a clean pitch for a surgical cleanup.
items.angle: keep the existing Wix contractor layout but replace template leftovers with real bathroom/painting value, stronger estimate CTA, and trust cues.

items.name: Premier Aquariums
items.summary: Simple Wix aquarium site has real service proof and email, but the homepage can better route reef, freshwater, maintenance, and consultation intent.
items.angle: retain the aquatic visual language while clarifying service cards, maintenance trust, consultation CTA, and next steps.

items.name: NG's Group Transportation
items.summary: Transportation site has a useful phone/quote path but the page can clean up template trust residue and make delivery services easier to choose.
items.angle: same freight-brand page with stronger quote CTA, local delivery/truckload paths, proof near hero, and placeholder/testimonial cleanup.

items.name: Park's Plumbing
items.summary: Local plumbing page has phone and service breadth, but dense copy and repeated service lists make urgent visitors work too hard.
items.angle: preserve the plain local plumbing style while separating emergency, water heater, drain, fixture, and camera-inspection paths with clear call/text action.

items.name: Palmer Personal Training
items.summary: Personal trainer site has good credibility but opens with off-brand payment-processing banner copy before the fitness promise, creating a quick-win hero cleanup.
items.angle: keep the straightforward trainer site feel while foregrounding fitness outcome, credentials, session CTA, and what happens after booking.

items.name: Keep It Greeen, Inc.
items.summary: Landscaping site has real phone numbers/licensed-insured proof but critical Wix placeholder paragraphs and generic service names remain on the homepage.
items.angle: same green landscaping site, cleaned of placeholders, with estimate CTA, licensed/insured trust, and real service categories above photos.

items.name: Pacific Paving, Inc.
items.summary: Contractor page shows a mismatched M&B Remodeling Interiors template and placeholder copy despite visible phone/license proof.
items.angle: preserve the contractor template skeleton but realign content around paving/asphalt services, estimate CTA, and Oregon CCB trust proof.

items.name: Dream Design Kitchen & Bath
items.summary: About/process page contains multiple Wix placeholder paragraphs, but the brand promise and online appointment path are already present.
items.angle: keep the clean remodeling layout while replacing placeholders with a credible process, trust proof, consultation CTA, and clearer next steps.
